g.text: Find the Winning Player in Coin Game
# The user retries it and the model journals what went wrong:
"simulated every move before looking for the pattern"
Quiz me on today's revisions. Call revisions_due, and for each problem call list_mistakes with its
platform and problem_id to see what I got wrong on it before. Ask me one question at a time about
how I would approach it and what I must not miss this time, built from those past mistakes, without
giving the answer. After I reply, rate my recall as again, hard, good or easy, then record it with
